text: House Goldcrest watches the crown grow rich and sure of itself, and does not like it.
The realm as the King found it: the great houses wary of the crown, of mixed temper.
The court sits for the autumn of 300: 1 matter waits for the King.
Lowri Wolfholt rules House Wolfholt, content and craven.
Beatrix Goldcrest rules House Goldcrest, greedy and ambitious.
Leod Ironreach rules House Ironreach, wrathful and pious.
Guthrum Thornvale rules House Thornvale, greedy and vengeful.
Nichola Stormhold rules House Stormhold, pious and craven.
Emmeline Sunspire rules House Sunspire, vengeful and ambitious.
Mabel Highfell rules House Highfell, just and vengeful.
Lowri Wolfholt of House Wolfholt asks to be heard at court.
Redmarch is marked out in the mud, and House Stormhold calls it a town.
Settlers under House Stormhold's banner raise the first roofs of Crowhold.
House Goldcrest plants a new town at Rosehall.
House Thornvale founds the town of Eaglefell.
Windcross is marked out in the mud, and House Ironreach calls it a town.
Settlers under House Sunspire's banner raise the first roofs of Moonhold.
House Sunspire founds the town of Highcrag.
House Wolfholt plants a new town at King's Crag.
The year 301 AC begins.
